title: Cohomology of a torsion sheaf, and of a complex with torsion cohomology, on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme is torsion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that torsion coefficients give torsion cohomology groups on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, for a single sheaf and for a bounded below complex (statement lines 13898-13907). The proof (proof lines 13909-13921) filters the sheaf by its d-torsion subsheaves and uses commutation with colimits for the first part, and the spectral sequence of a complex together with the sheaf case for the second. H2: two short arguments, written out.
